使用说明：把你原视频的提示词重新放进输入框并且加载好原有的参考素材点击运行即可
该方法放大并不局限于h3生成的视频，其实是通用的，你拿seedance生成的视频来放大都行（只是提示词要按h3的形式写一下）

widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young woman in <Picture 1>, with shoulder-length dark hair with bangs, fair skin, wearing a low-cut white top with a plunging neckline, an open light-blue short-sleeved button-up shirt, and denim shorts.
<Subject 2> is the brightly lit supermarket snack aisle in <Picture 1>, featuring multi-tiered shelves stocked with colorful snack packaging beneath exposed ceiling ductwork, with a red accent wall bearing the white text "MART".
<Subject 3> is a colorful, puffy foil bag of potato chips selected from the snack shelves of <Subject 2>.

summary:
[reference generation] The target video is a vertical smartphone vlog featuring <Subject 1> browsing and shopping in <Subject 2>. Picking up and showcasing <Subject 3>, she delivers three enthusiastic lines of dialogue directly to the viewer across three distinct shots.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - the woman's facial features, hairstyle with bangs, open light-blue shirt over the low-cut white top, denim shorts, and lively influencer persona are retained.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - the supermarket interior, snack displays, ceiling lights, and red "MART" background are retained across all angles.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - the colorful foil bag of potato chips is consistently held and showcased.

detailed_description:
The target video uses a realistic, live-action vertical smartphone vlog style with warm, commercial indoor lighting.
[Shot 1] A high-angle selfie medium close-up frames <Subject 1> standing in <Subject 2>, holding up <Subject 3>, a vibrant bag of potato chips, and admiring it. She lowers the snack bag slightly and looks directly into the front-facing camera with a charming, bright smile. The lively young woman with a sweet, cheerful voice (S1) says: <d>[Chinese] 这款零食看起来好好吃！</d> while the camera moves with slight natural handheld shake.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.500, the shot cuts to a profile medium shot of <Subject 1> standing beside the shelves in <Subject 2>. She picks up <Subject 3> from the shelf, inspects the packaging in both hands, and then turns her torso toward the camera with a radiant expression, lifting <Subject 3> beside her cheek. In the same upbeat, enthusiastic voice, <Subject 1> (S1) says: <d>[Chinese] 我决定买这个，包装也太可爱了吧！</d>
[Shot 3] At 00:04.800, the shot cuts to a vertical medium-full shot framed from the mid-thigh up in the center aisle. <Subject 1> stands facing the camera, holding <Subject 3> in her right hand before waving her left hand toward the lens in a friendly parting gesture. With an energetic, teasing smile, <Subject 1> (S1) says: <d>[Chinese] 走啦，回家一起试吃！</d> and maintains her beaming smile through the final frame.

overall_soundscape:
Subtle ambient retail store room tone, a quiet low background ventilation hum, the crisp crinkling of the foil potato chip bag, and soft fabric rustling accompany the character's movements.

non_diegetic_music:
A bright, upbeat acoustic vlog track featuring bouncy rhythmic acoustic guitar strumming and light percussive beats at a moderate tempo playing steadily underneath the dialogue.
